set.body: Found during the 2026-09-17 eyes4s.md sync. PRD RA-1 and the v1.1 Construal/EntityTrace design presuppose an entity-keyed AoiSet[U, E]. Commits 894fe38 and 8b4db05 shipped AoiSet[U] keyed by AoiId with MembershipPolicy (Multiple, ExclusiveByPriority, SmallestContaining, RejectOverlap) and no decision was recorded. Owner decision needed: adopt AoiId keys and amend PRD RA-1 and the v1.1 section, or plan a migration to entity keys before the visual-world epic (bd-01KYDZ8V30PVKAQ78PY2J9SNB2) starts. eyes4s.md marks the section 'Decision open (2026-09-17)'.
set.title: Decision: AoiSet entity keys (PRD RA-1 AoiSet[U, E]) versus shipped AoiSet[U] with AoiId
